labels.reason: The body reports a 20-fold lung bacterial-load reduction relative to surfactant without PMB. Treatment context is intratracheal surfactant 200 mg/kg plus PMB 1% w/w before inoculation in neonatal rabbits with E. coli 25922. This is reported relative PD evidence, with no serial PMB concentrations in the stated local archive. DR001, DR002, DR003 and DR008 have partial source support only; the item does not establish PK input availability, rabbit component identifiability or eligible K. pneumoniae exposure-response records.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T3:A33 identifies a reported relative endpoint. The body provides an endpoint, value, unit and comparator, but no experimental-unit identifiers, sample count, aggregation definition, variability or original measurement records. Individual, pooled and group-summary status cannot be established.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported experimental-unit and aggregation definitions, sample counts, available variability and provenance for the reported 20-fold endpoint. Preserve the endpoint without reconstructing individual records.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T3:A32 states surfactant 200 mg/kg plus PMB 1% w/w administered intratracheally before inoculation. The 200 mg/kg value belongs to surfactant. PMB salt/free-base basis, absolute administered PMB amount and total/free concentration basis are unspecified; no concentration or physiological bridge is supplied.
findings.needed_material: Clarify PMB formulation and dose basis before any dose conversion or exposure linkage. Retain surfactant dose and PMB composition separately without calculating a PMB dose.

findings.reason: No concentration-time observations are supplied. F0003:S3:T3:A33 explicitly limits its negative statement to serial PMB concentration data in the local archive. The relative PD endpoint does not establish PK sampling, exposure or dose-history inputs.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked rabbit PMB concentration-time observations and their dosing, sampling, matrix, concentration-basis and experimental-unit metadata if this experiment is proposed for animal PK modeling. Retain availability as unresolved beyond this reviewed item.

findings.reason: The reported response concerns E. coli 25922, so it cannot set K. pneumoniae targets under R14. Available context includes a surfactant-without-PMB comparator, pretreatment before inoculation and a four-hour ventilation experiment. Raw bacterial counts, baseline, exact response observation time, inoculum, immune status, matched MIC, exposure-response mapping and frequency/interval variation are not supplied.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of any separate contextual use of this E. coli endpoint. K. pneumoniae index ranking or target estimation requires eligible, source-matched K. pneumoniae response, susceptibility, regimen and exposure inputs with defined response timing and reference point.

findings.reason: MI002 remains NOT_FOUND and OPEN, needed_at adequacy. Its supplied origin reports that no further public rabbit PMB concentration data were found. F0003:S3:T3:A33 instead states that no serial PMB concentrations are present in the local archive. These search scopes must remain distinct; neither establishes absence from all sources or unread attachments.
findings.needed_material: Adequacy-stage assessment recording the reported public-search limit, this item's narrower local-archive statement and their consequences for rabbit evidence eligibility. Record an explicit permitted outcome for MI002 before the dependent decision.

findings.reason: MI003 remains DEFERRED and OPEN, needed_at pk. This item supplies a relative pulmonary PD endpoint without serial PMB concentrations and does not establish an identifiable rabbit PK component. No inclusion, exclusion or exploratory-use decision under SC011 is supported at this labeling step.
findings.needed_material: Forward MI003 unchanged to the PK assessment, preserving the available endpoint and source limitations.
